name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Après le § 37 - Am 14
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text: 37a. Notes that systemic delays and inadequate record preservation practices identified in Ombudsman inquiries and case-law demonstrate structural shortcomings in the current framework; calls for the revised transparency rules to include enforceable consequences where institutions fail to preserve documents or repeatedly disregard statutory deadlines, including proportionate administrative and disciplinary measures; stresses that transparency obligations must be effective in practice and not merely declaratory;
